g.text: Decision capability depends on the representation and the declared prior
Left: green points are Pareto candidates under accuracy, duration, AND pitch-count axes; this is not a listener recommendation.
Right: exact finite input cases [50] and [51], threshold 51; sampled priors only. No measured human performance or natural frequency claim.
